channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Laura Cardoso e destaca legado da atriz: 'Sua imagem estará sempre na memória de gerações'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mourned the death of actress Laura Cardoso, aged 98, highlighting her legacy in building Brazilian theater and television. He recalled that she received the Order of Cultural Merit in 2007 and was promoted to Grand Cross in 2025, and expressed solidarity with her family and colleagues.

item.title: Greenpeace: Lula afasta Brasil do pacto climático com petróleo na Amazônia
item.description: The announcement of a new oil discovery in the Amazon’s Foz region has led Greenpeace Brazil to claim the country is moving away from its climate and environmental commitments, according to Mariana Andrade, coordinator of the Oceans Front. The criticism was made during an interview on UOL News, emphasizing ecological risks associated with oil exploration in the sensitive Amazon region.

item.title: Renan Santos defende acabar com Justiça do Trabalho, diz que CLT 'já era' e critica fim da 6x1
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos from the Missão party advocated for abolishing Brazil's Labor Justice system, stating that the CLT is 'already obsolete' and that labor disputes should be handled in Civil Justice. He also criticized the end of the 6x1 workweek, arguing that labor flexibility is essential for economic competitiveness.

item.title: Lula antecipa herança aos filhos na véspera da nova tributação
item.description: Lula advanced part of his inheritance to his children between 2022 and 2023, reducing his declared assets from R$7.4 million to R$4.8 million, according to Electoral Court filings. The transfers coincided with the approval of a tax reform making ITCMD (inheritance tax) progressive, but there is no evidence the move was motivated by tax avoidance.

item.title: André e Derrite dizem que defenderão pauta "anti-STF" caso eleitos
item.description: Senate candidates Guilherme Derrite (PP) and André do Prado (PL), backed by Flávio Bolsonaro, stated they will defend an 'anti-STF' agenda if elected, including proposals to impeach justices, impose 12-year terms, and raise the minimum age for entry into higher courts from 35 to 50. Although allies have advised them to avoid immediate confrontation with the Supreme Court, both candidates said they will follow the PL's direction and support reforms proposed by the São Paulo Bar Association, though they have not emphasized the issue in recent campaign appearances, focusing instead on public security and criticism of the PT.

item.title: Mendonça manda Lula tirar do ar trecho de discurso em convenção no PT da Bahia com 'pedido direto de voto'
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to remove, within 24 hours, video excerpts from a speech at the PT’s Bahia convention where he made direct appeals for votes, which may constitute illegal early electioneering. The order also applies to Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues and the national PT directory, following a complaint by the Novo Party, which argued that statements like 'vote for me' and 'elect me for a fourth time' go beyond permissible internal party mobilization and constitute explicit voter solicitation.

item.title: Caiado apresenta plano para Saúde ao lado de ex-ministro de Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) presented his government health plan in São Paulo, emphasizing SUS modernization, defense of science and vaccination, and criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for lacking congressional majority to pass reforms. The plan was developed with input from former Health Minister Luiz Henrique Mandetta (União Brasil), who served during the Covid-19 pandemic. Caiado also stated that anti-vaccine theories cost the 2022 election and pledged to confront health denialists.

item.title: TSE manda remover post que ligava Flávio Bolsonaro a homicídio
item.description: The TSE unanimously ordered the removal of a post on X attributing responsibility for the murder of lawyer Rodrigo Marinho Crespo to Flávio Bolsonaro, ruling the accusation lacked minimal proof and exceeded the bounds of political criticism. The decision, formalized on August 15, 2026, bans reposting under penalty of fine, reinforcing protection of electoral debate against serious disinformation.

item.title: Risco de golpe foi “iminente” sob Bolsonaro, diz ex-comandante da FAB
item.description: Former Brazilian Air Force commander Carlos Baptista Junior claims the risk of a coup was imminent in late 2022, with President Bolsonaro pressuring military leaders to overturn Lula’s election victory. He feared a fracture in the armed forces, especially if the Army deviated from the legalist stance of General Freire Gomes. Baptista Junior defended the military’s November 2022 note as a measure to avoid bloodshed, while acknowledging he voted for Bolsonaro in both 2018 and 2022.

item.title: O ‘inferno astral’ dos marqueteiros nas campanhas presidenciais de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 presidential campaigns, several marketing strategists are being replaced due to strategic disagreements and misalignment, such as Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) losing Paulo Vasconcelos over differences on how to attack Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and Augusto Cury (Avante) replacing Leandro Grôppo with Sergio Lima. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign has already changed consultants twice, indicating instability in communication teams. These changes occur at a critical time, as free electoral airtime on radio and TV begins on August 28, leaving little room for adjustments.

item.title: Romero Jucá desiste de disputar vaga de deputado federal por Roraima nas eleições 2026
item.description: Romero Jucá, former senator and president of MDB in Roraima, announced he will not run for federal deputy in the 2026 elections, citing personal and family attacks as the reason, despite having his ineligibility reversed by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. He stated he prefers not to engage in a 'low and vile' political dispute and made the decision responsibly with family support. Jucá has a long political career, including three senatorial terms, ministerial roles in the Lula and Temer administrations, and Senate leadership under multiple presidents.

item.title: Caiado diz que ‘filhos de Bolsonaro’ ajudaram Lula a voltar ao poder e que seguem auxiliando com ‘picuinhas’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, criticized Jair Bolsonaro's sons, claiming that if they had more sense, Lula would not have returned to power. He accused Bolsonaro's heirs of engaging in petty social media 'squabbles' to gain attention, despite having supported Bolsonaro in 2018 and later distancing himself during the pandemic over denialism. Caiado also noted he served as governor of Goiás during that time and witnessed the sons' influence on the former president.

item.title: Augusto Cury defende mandato de 8 anos para ministros do STF
item.description: Augusto Cury, the Avante party's presidential candidate, proposed an 8-year term for Supreme Federal Court justices, replacing the current life tenure until age 75. He also advocates that the appointment of justices should no longer be made by the president but by the respective professional associations (judges, Public Ministry, and OAB), while retaining Senate approval.

item.title: Ex-BBB Lucas Penteado se candidata a deputado; relembre polêmicas
item.description: Lucas Penteado, former BBB 21 contestant and actor known from Malhação and Nosso Sonho, is running for federal deputy under the Workers' Party (PT) in São Paulo. His candidacy comes five years after his controversial exit from the reality show, which involved conflicts with Karol Conká and Projota, as well as mental health concerns. He declared R$1,200 in assets to the TSE, representing 12% of the capital of his company LKP Produções Artísticas Ltda.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Laura Cardoso: ‘Ajudou a construir o nosso teatro e a nossa televisão’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mourned the death of actress Laura Cardoso, aged 98, highlighting her contributions to Brazilian theater and television. Lula noted he awarded her the Order of Cultural Merit in 2007 and promoted her to Grand Cross in 2025, officially recognizing her importance to national culture.

item.title: “Carta ao Lula de 1979”: em vídeo, petista relembra trajetória
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva released a video addressing his '1979 self', reflecting on his journey of struggle, resistance, and dreams for the nation. He states he overcame hardships, rebuilt Brazil by 2026, and highlights achievements in food security, healthcare, and education, while acknowledging that more progress is still needed.

item.title: Michelle diz que Bolsonaro mandou "abraço hétero" para deputado do DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and Senate candidate from the Federal District, said Jair Bolsonaro sent a 'hetero hug' to federal deputy Alberto Fraga during the launch of Fraga's campaign. She also urged unity to elect Flávio Bolsonaro as president and expressed respect for José Roberto Arruda, despite not endorsing him. Michelle reaffirmed her support for Governor Celina Leão's re-election.

item.title: "Precisamos eleger Flávio Bolsonaro", diz Michelle em evento do DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, Senate candidate for the Federal District, declared her support for stepson Flávio Bolsonaro as the 2026 presidential candidate during the launch of Alberto Fraga’s re-election campaign. She urged unity to elect the 'Bolsonaro heart ticket,' calling it a decisive moment. Fraga, Arruda, and Bia Kicis also voiced support for Fraga’s congressional re-election bid.

item.title: "Meu 1° ato como presidente vai ser acabar com as bets", diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for the Novo party, stated that his first act as president would be to ban online betting, which he called a 'plague' and 'cancer' indebting 80% of Brazilian families. He also announced plans to reduce the number of ministries from 38 to 22 or 23, implement administrative and pension reforms, review social programs, and privatize public sectors, aiming to save trillions of reais over 20 years.

item.title: Lei da regularização das favelas expõe contradição do PT no STF
item.description: The PT is challenging Law 13.465/2017 before the STF, claiming it harms poor populations, yet the Lula administration has used the same law to expand Minha Casa, Minha Vida and social interest land regularization programs. Minister Flávio Dino’s partial ruling preserved the law’s application in Reurb-S (low-income) while restricting it in Reurb-E, highlighting a contradiction between the party’s judicial stance and its policy implementation.

item.title: Flávio faz caminhada com Roscoe e Nikolas após a aceno a Cleitinho, em Belo Horizonte
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) joined a walk with supporters in Belo Horizonte on Tuesday (18), alongside Roscoe and Nikolas, to strengthen the Liberal Party’s slate in Minas Gerais. The event followed a gesture of support for Cleitinho, reinforcing the PL’s political coordination in the state.

item.title: O novo ‘cabo eleitoral’ de Lula que pode mexer com a disputa pelo Planalto
item.description: The announcement of oil discovery in the Foz do Amazonas Basin in Amapá was characterized by columnist Robson Bonin as a purely electoral move by Lula, who revived the 'passport to the future' rhetoric from the pre-salt era to link fossil fuel extraction with national progress, even while affirming commitments to biofuels and renewable energy sources.

item.title: Cury defende 'impostos altíssimos' para bets, escala 5x2 e prazo de 8 anos no STF para ministros
item.description: Augusto Cury, the Avante party's presidential candidate, advocated for extremely high taxes on betting companies, support for a 5x2 work schedule, and a maximum 8-year term for Supreme Court justices. He argued that betting leads to addiction and diverts resources from consumption and commerce, affecting families, society, national thinking, and businesses. The remarks were made during the 'Encontro com Presidenciáveis - Diálogo pelo Futuro do Brasil' event hosted by Unecs.

item.title: Flávio mira zona leste e interior paulista em início de campanha em SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) launches his presidential campaign in São Paulo with street agendas in the city's east zone, accompanied by Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB), including visits to the Mercadão de São Miguel, the Solidarity Warehouse, and a youth soccer school in Vila Formosa. On Saturday, he plans to visit Ribeirão Preto and attend the Barretos Rodeo Festival — a traditional interior São Paulo event previously attended by Jair Bolsonaro — with possible attendance from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos).

item.title: Renan Santos defende fim da Justiça do Trabalho e da escala 6×1
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão coalition, advocated for abolishing the Labor Justice system and the 6×1 work scale during a UNECS event in Brasília, proposing hourly-paid contracts as an alternative.

item.title: Ministros do TSE se reúnem para discutir vídeo de Bolsonaro com IA
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court met to discuss the application of Resolution 23.732/2024, which bans the use of AI in electoral campaigns, following a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro used at the convention nominating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate. The video, aimed at mobilizing voters, may be deemed irregular given Bolsonaro’s house arrest and prohibition on disseminating political manifestos. Chaired by Kassio Nunes Marques, the meeting aims to establish a precedent for regulating AI use in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Pablo Marçal corrige declaração de bens e registra no TSE que tem R$ 149,9 milhões
item.description: PRTB presidential candidate Pablo Marçal submitted a corrected asset declaration to the TSE, reducing his reported wealth from over R$7 billion to R$149.9 million, citing a data entry error. Despite being declared ineligible until 2032 by the TRE-SP for misusing communication channels in 2024, Marçal attempted to register his candidacy after switching parties, with the TSE still reviewing the request.

item.title: Tarcísio se solidariza com Marina após intimidação e diz que responsáveis devem ser punidos
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas expressed solidarity with Senate candidate Marina Silva after she reported being intimidated during a campaign walk in São Paulo. He stated that those responsible should be punished and emphasized the importance of respect in the electoral process.

item.title: Caiado volta a negar apoio ao PT num eventual 2º turno: 'sempre fui oposição ao Lula'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate and former governor of Goiás, reiterated that he will not support the PT in a potential runoff, reaffirming his longstanding opposition to President Lula. The statement was made during the presentation of his government plan for the health sector.

item.title: Renan Santos defende fim da Justiça do Trabalho e chama redução de escala 6×1 de ‘maluquice’
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party for president, advocated for abolishing the Labor Justice system and called the proposal to reduce the 6×1 work schedule 'madness', claiming it would destroy the economy. He also stated that the CLT 'is already dead' and accused Congress of cowardice for yielding to the government and Erika Hilton's proposal.

item.title: Governador do MA vai ao STF para pedir suspensão de inquérito
item.description: Maranhão Governor Carlos Brandão has filed a request with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to immediately suspend decisions by Minister Flávio Dino in an investigation into alleged public fund embezzlement in the state, arguing that Dino has usurped constitutional competence, as governors should be tried in the Superior Court of Justice (STJ). The defense claims Brandão learned of the rulings only through the press and was never formally notified or granted access to sealed investigation documents, citing as aurgent factor Dino’s August 17, 2026 order to remove Brandão’s nephew, Daniel Brandão, as president of the TCE-MA.

item.title: Edinho diz que PT quer ampliar ‘diálogo’ para formar frente ‘antibolsonarista’
item.description: PT President Edinho Silva stated that Lula's re-election campaign will begin dialogue efforts to broaden support, even after the coalition registration deadline, focusing on informal endorsements and attracting parties and leaders outside the national ticket. He emphasized the PSD as the PT's main state-level ally outside the national coalition, and noted that regional alliances with MDB, PP, and União Brasil will serve as bridges to expand the antibolsonarist front. The government program will be refined during the campaign, with ongoing discussions on key issues.

item.title: Caiado defende uso de IA para reduzir custos da saúde
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) unveiled a health plan advocating for AI to reduce public health system costs, emphasizing prevention, digital integration, and national production of medicines and vaccines. The proposal includes linking basic health units to hospitals within one hour, implementing genomic records for early disease detection, and launching a 100-day agenda featuring a national health missions committee, a census of strategic queues, and a map of critical care gaps. The plan was developed with former Health Minister Luiz Henrique Mandetta and endorsed by the Caiado-Kassab ticket.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter recebido 1,8 mil ameaças e usa colete à prova de balas em caminhada em BH
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed to have received over 1,8 thousand death threats since announcing he would classify criminal factions like PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. He participated in a walk in Belo Horizonte wearing a bulletproof vest, alongside Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Roscoe, and reiterated proposals to lower the age of criminal responsibility to 14 and allow driver’s licenses at 16. Nikolas Ferreira defended Jair Bolsonaro’s imprisonment as a stand against the 'system' and emphasized the election’s importance for shaping the STF and potentially impeaching Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Pesquisa eleitoral mostra distância entre Lula e Flávio no estado da Lava-Jato
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the presidential race in Paraná with 44% voting intentions, followed by Lula at 31%, according to Real Time Big Data poll. In a simulated runoff, Flávio extends his lead to 52% against Lula’s 35%. Columnist Robson Bonin attributes the result to Paraná’s strong conservative leanings, shaped by economic ties to São Paulo and Santa Catarina, while noting Lula retains support in rural areas linked to land reform and peasant movements.

item.title: Renan diz que acabar com 6x1 é 'maluquice', afirma que CLT 'já era' e defende fim da Justiça do Trabalho
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, called ending the 6x1 work schedule a 'madness' and advocated for abolishing the CLT and Labor Justice. He criticized Congress for yielding to government and Erika Hilton's project pressure, claiming it would cause 'economic wreckage'. The remarks were made at the Encontro com Presidenciáveis - Diálogo pelo Futuro do Brasil event, organized by Unecs.

item.title: Augusto Cury troca marqueteiro às vésperas do início da propaganda eleitoral
item.description: Augusto Cury, the Avante party's presidential candidate, replaced his marketing chief Leandro Grôppo with Sergio Lima just days before the start of free electoral advertising on radio and TV, set for August 28. The campaign described the change as a natural strategic alignment for the heightened exposure phase, denying any conflict with the former aide. Sergio Lima previously worked on Cury's pre-campaign and also served in Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 presidential campaign.

item.title: Eleição: homem, branco e empresário é perfil majoritário de candidatos
item.description: The TSE registered 20,530 candidacy requests for the 2026 elections, 8,732 fewer than in 2022. The majority profile is male (65%), white (48.77%), with completed higher education (58.57%), and most candidates are running for state deputy (11,103 requests). The highest competition per vacancy is for district deputy (17.5 candidates per seat) and federal deputy (14.88).

item.title: Suspeito de balear ex-mulher, antigo colaborador de Milei e aliado de Eduardo Bolsonaro é preso
item.description: Argentine influencer Fernando Cerimedo, known for 2022 live streams spreading false information about Brazil's electronic voting system, was arrested on Tuesday, the 18th, at Guarulhos International Airport. He is suspected of shooting his ex-wife and has ties to Javier Milei's government in Argentina, as well as being an ally of Brazilian deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro. The arrest was carried out under a preventive detention order issued by Brazilian justice.

item.title: Marçal declara R$ 149,9 milhões em bens, R$ 20 milhões a menos que em 2024
item.description: Influencer and businessman Pablo Marçal, PRTB's presidential candidate, declared R$149.9 million in assets to the TSE, R$20 million less than in 2024. Despite being judicially ineligible, he obtained an injunction allowing him to register his candidacy for the 2026 elections.

item.title: André Mendonça manda Lula apagar pedido de voto em convenção na Bahia
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ordered President Lula and allies to remove from online platforms excerpts of a speech delivered at the PT convention in Bahia containing an early vote request, which violates electoral law. The decision partially grants a petition by the Novo party and mandates the deletion only of passages with explicit suffrage solicitation. The minister stated that early campaigning with vote requests undermines equality in the electoral race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usa pesquisas internas e diz que já está na frente de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) claims he is already ahead of Lula (PT) in internal polling for the 2026 presidential race, though he acknowledges that in publicly released polls from last week, he trails Lula in the first round outside the margin of error and is tied with him in the second round within the margin of error.

item.title: Flávio acusa autoridades de pressionarem Centrão e diz que usará imagem de Bolsonaro dentro da lei
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro said he intends to use his father Jair Bolsonaro's image within legal limits in the 2026 presidential campaign, and accused authorities of pressuring Centrão parties not to support his candidacy, though without providing evidence or names. He also renewed his criticism of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, claiming the former president is being unfairly restricted, including in contact with family.

item.title: O circo do vazio e os donos das sombras: a quem interessa a rinha política?
item.description: The text criticizes the degradation of Brazilian politics into a 'reverse sophistication,' where intellectual emptiness is monetized through superficial social media content. Candidates emerge from digital engagement without territorial or programmatic bases, prioritizing likes and shock over substantive proposals. This dynamic subverts checks and balances, turning the legislature into an algorithmic theater driven by empty ideological stereotypes.

item.title: Flávio ataca "Marcolão" e família de Lula: "Portas abertas em vários ministérios"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula's family and former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola) of using public offices to facilitate business deals for the presidential family with public funds, citing intercepted PF messages involving the president's son, Lulinha, and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. He claimed Marcola 'opened the doors' of several ministries for these schemes and vowed to hold those responsible accountable, particularly regarding alleged misappropriation of INSS funds affecting retirees.

item.title: “Até Lula aponta excessos no STF, mas nada acontece”, desabafa empresário investigado por Moraes
item.description: Businessman Marcelo Conde, under investigation for allegedly purchasing and leaking the income tax declaration of lawyer Viviane Barci de Moraes — wife of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes — criticized the lack of consequences despite President Lula’s public remarks about excesses in the STF. Conde argues that even Lula acknowledges judicial arbitrariness, yet nothing changes, reflecting societal and institutional cowardice. His defense has requested that Minister Moraes recuse himself due to his marital ties to the alleged victim, a motion that may be reviewed this week.

item.title: Michelle diz que vai participar de ato com Flávio no DF e faz novo gesto de aproximação após pedido de voto
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro confirmed she plans to campaign alongside Flávio Bolsonaro in the Federal District, marking a rapprochement after pre-campaign tensions. She urged support for the PL presidential ticket while balancing her Senate bid with caregiving for Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest. The event also featured José Roberto Arruda, exposing a rift as Alberto Fraga endorsed Arruda for governor despite Michelle’s backing of Fraga.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro não é única ex-primeira-dama a se candidatar — saiba quem foi a pioneira
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro registered her Senate candidacy for the Federal District, becoming the second former first lady to run for public office in Brazil. The first was Rosane Malta (formerly Rosane Collor), who ran for the Alagoas State Legislative Assembly in 2018 under the PHS, receiving 459 votes and losing. Despite being married to Jair Bolsonaro and ineligible, Michelle is polling as a frontrunner in the DF Senate race, tied with Leila do Vôlei (PDT).

item.title: Áudio: Liberada a propaganda eleitoral nas redes
item.description: Starting this week, candidates can conduct electoral propaganda on social media, including live streams, provided their official channels are registered with the TSE. Paid propaganda is limited to parties, federations, and coalitions and must be clearly labeled, including AI-generated or significantly altered content. Voters, however, remain free to express support for candidates without cost or restriction.

item.title: Kiko Caputo planeja construir quatro estradas parques no DF
item.description: Kiko Caputo (Novo), candidate for Governor of the Federal District, proposed building four park roads in Águas Claras, Brazlândia, Recanto das Emas, and Planaltina to ease traffic, alongside suggesting privatization of non-essential DF areas. He also discussed health, education, and economic projects, including a Brasília-Goiânia train, Metrô-DF expansion, and new BRTs. Caputo was the second candidate interviewed in Rádio Metrópoles’ sabatina series, which will cover all 2026 GDF candidates.
